<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Employee submits vacation request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Supervisor receives request"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Supervisor approves or rejects request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" name="Request approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnApplication" name="Return application to employee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejection" name="Employee reviews rejection reasons"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejection reviewed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProcedures" name="Human Resources Representative completes management procedures"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Management procedures completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReturnApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalOutcome" targetRef="Task_GenerateNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ReturnApplication" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_GenerateNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
